high_level_description: This image captures a dynamic scene on the open sea, likely during a fishing expedition. The main focus is on a large fish, possibly a sailfish or marlin, with its distinctive elongated dorsal fin (sail) prominently displayed. The fish's tail is spread wide, showcasing its vibrant purple and blue hues, which are characteristic of these species. A person, dressed in a light-colored long-sleeve shirt and a cap, is leaning over the side of a boat to interact with the fish. The individual appears to be either releasing the fish back into the water or preparing to handle it.
